registryEntry.label: Alert Policy - Audit Logging Changed or Turned Off
registryEntry.get_command: Get-ProtectionAlert | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ Name = $_.Name; Disabled = $_.Disabled; Severity = $_.Severity; Operation = @($_.Operation); NotifyUser = @($_.NotifyUser) } } | Where-Object { ($_.Name -eq 'CMMC-Audit-Logging-Changed') -or (($_.Disabled -eq $false) -and (@($_.Operation) -contains 'Set-AdminAuditLogConfig') -and (@($_.NotifyUser | Where-Object { $_ }).Count -gt 0)) } | Sort-Object { $_.Name -ne 'CMMC-Audit-Logging-Changed' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
registryEntry.set_command: New-ProtectionAlert -Name 'CMMC-Audit-Logging-Changed' -Category Others -ThreatType Activity -Operation 'Set-AdminAuditLogConfig' -NotifyUser '{cisoEmail}' -Severity High -AggregationType None -Comment 'CMMC AU.L2-3.3.4: alerts the named security contact when the audit log configuration is changed or turned off (audit logging process failure).'
